versions.changelog:
Sci-Hub-Search 0.1.0 — Initial Release

- Enables searching for academic papers by DOI, title, or keyword via Sci-Hub.
- Retrieves paper metadata, including title, author, year, and download URL.
- Supports direct PDF downloads and handles multiple Sci-Hub mirrors.
- Provides a command-line interface with optional environment configuration.
- Includes setup and usage guides for Python users across uv, conda, and pip environments.
